name: Pinnacle Peak Park trailhead lot, 102nd Way (Scottsdale)
basis: City of Scottsdale park page: park address 26802 N 102nd Way, climbing permitted in three areas of the park; a listing describes a single ~90-space paved lot; rockclimbing.com directions: parking area and trailhead on the west side of the road below the east flank of the peak. Brief lot w29473680 is the only unrestricted lot at that spot (access yes, no fee), ~300 m from the crags.
